title: StyleSPADE: Realistic Image Augmentation for Robust Infrastructure Crack Segmentation via Ensemble Learning
mechanism: Conditional generator combining SPADE mask normalisation with a style exemplar image, keeping crack geometry from the mask and background texture from the exemplar.
adaptation: Style exemplar = pool cell from a target group (half-cut CSIR, BMRK, CFVS without twin); mask = a train mask; renders every train mask in every source style. Pixel space, so 1-2 px cracks are representable.
min_experiment: PF + train masks rendered with BMRK, CFVS, half-cut CSIR exemplars vs PF. Metric weak-source CV crack IoU and E1 relF1@2. Kill: both gains < +0.02. About 20 GPU-h.
evidence: R: crack IoU 0.6376, F1 0.7586 with StyleSPADE data across Mask2Former, Swin-UPerNet, K-Net; 0.6452 with stacking ensemble.
